2: 
3: export type User = { id: string; email: string; name: string; passwordHash: string };
4: 
5: const users = new Map<string, User>();
6: 
7: function hashPassword(password: string, salt = randomBytes(16).toString("hex")): string {
8:   return `${salt}:${scryptSync(password, salt, 32).toString("hex")}`;
9: }
10: 
11: function checkPassword(password: string, stored: string): boolean {
12:   const [salt, hash] = stored.split(":");
13:   const candidate = scryptSync(password, salt, 32);
14:   return timingSafeEqual(candidate, Buffer.from(hash, "hex"));
15: }
16: 
17: export class UserError extends Error {}
18: 
19: /** Register a user. Emails are unique (case-insensitive). */
20: export function createUser(email: string, name: string, password: string): User {
21:   const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase();
22:   if (!/^[^@\s]+@[^@\s]+$/.test(normalized)) throw new UserError("invalid email");
23:   if (password.length < 8) throw new UserError("password must be at least 8 characters");
24:   if (findUserByEmail(normalized)) throw new UserError("email already registered");
25:   const user: User = { id: `u_${randomBytes(6).toString("hex")}`, email: normalized, name: name.trim() || normalized, passwordHash: hashPassword(password) };
26:   users.set(user.id, user);
27:   return user;
28: }
29: 
30: export function findUserByEmail(email: string): User | undefined {
31:   const normalized = email.trim().toLowerCase();
32:   for (const u of users.values()) if (u.email === normalized) return u;
33:   return undefined;
34: }
35: 
36: export function getUser(id: string): User | undefined {
37:   return users.get(id);
38: }
39: 
40: /** The user for an email/password pair, or undefined. */
41: export function authenticate(email: string, password: string): User | undefined {
42:   const user = findUserByEmail(email);
43:   return user && checkPassword(password, user.passwordHash) ? user : undefined;
44: }

46: /** Public view of a user (never the password hash). */
47: export function publicUser(user: User): { id: string; email: string; name: string } {
48:   return { id: user.id, email: user.email, name: user.name };
49: }

53:   users.clear();
